GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id;

WITH txn_cust AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_amount,
           ft.transaction_date,
           strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS month,
           cc.customer_id
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
),
cust_month AS (
    SELECT month,
           customer_id,
           SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_amount,
           AVG(transaction_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM txn_cust
    GROUP BY month, customer_id
),
month_avg AS (
    SELECT month,
           AVG(transaction_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM txn_cust
    GROUP BY month
),
cust_with_tier AS (
    SELECT cm.month,
           cm.customer_id,
           cm.total_amount,
           cm.avg_amount,
           MAX(a.other_account_details) AS loyalty_tier
    FROM cust_month cm
    JOIN month_avg ma ON cm.month = ma.month
    LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = cm.customer_id
    WHERE cm.avg_amount > ma.overall_avg
    GROUP BY cm.month, cm.customer_id, cm.total_amount, cm.avg_amount
)
SELECT month,
       customer_id,
       loyalty_tier,
       total_amount
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM cust_with_tier
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY month, rn;

WITH Monthly_Customer_Aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS calendar_month,
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount,
        AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date), c.customer_id
),
Monthly_Overall_Averages AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month,
        AVG(avg_transaction_amount) AS overall_avg_amount
    FROM Monthly_Customer_Aggregates
    GROUP BY calendar_month
),
Filtered_Ranked_Customers AS (
    SELECT 
        mca.calendar_month,
        mca.customer_id,
        mca.customer_first_name,
        mca.customer_last_name,
        a.other_account_details AS loyalty_tier,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mca.calendar_month ORDER BY mca.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS rank_num
    FROM Monthly_Customer_Aggregates mca
    JOIN Monthly_Overall_Averages moa ON mca.calendar_month = moa.calendar_month
    JOIN Accounts a ON mca.customer_id = a.customer_id
    WHERE mca.avg_transaction_amount > moa.overall_avg_amount
)
SELECT customer_first_name, customer_last_name, loyalty_tier
FROM Filtered_Ranked_Customers
WHERE rank_num <= 3;

Mathematically, this represents the mean of the means, which gives equal weight to customers regardless of how many transactions they made. The standard interpretation of "average transaction amount across all customers" is the global average of all individual transactions (`SUM(all amounts) / COUNT(all transactions)`). These two metrics are not equivalent, making the filter condition logically inconsistent with the question's requirement.

    GROUP BY month, c.customer_id

monthly_overall AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS month,
        AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    GROUP BY month
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        mc.month,
        mc.customer_id,
        mc.total_amount,
        mc.avg_amount,
        mo.overall_avg
    FROM monthly_cust mc
    JOIN monthly_overall mo ON mc.month = mo.month
    WHERE mc.avg_amount > mo.overall_avg
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.month ORDER BY f.total_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM filtered f
)
SELECT
    r.month,
    r.customer_id,
    MIN(a.account_name) AS loyalty_tier
FROM ranked r
JOIN Accounts a ON r.customer_id = a.customer_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
GROUP BY r.month, r.customer_id, r.rn
ORDER BY r.month, r.rn;

SELECT c.other_customer_details AS credit_risk_score, c.customer_id
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(ft.transaction_id) > 5;

WITH payment_counts AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS payment_count
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= date('now','start of year')
      AND ft.transaction_date < date('now','start of year','+1 year')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(ft.transaction_id) > 5
)
SELECT c.credit_risk_assessment_score, c.financial_stability_rating
FROM Customers c
JOIN payment_counts pc ON pc.customer_id = c.customer_id;

WITH monthly_points AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        strftime('%m', ft.transaction_date) AS month,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_points
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - 1
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, month
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    month,
    total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS month_rank
FROM monthly_points
ORDER BY customer_id, month;

WITH MonthlyTransactionSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS month_year,
        SUM(COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0)) AS total_points
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) = CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 1
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date)
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_year,
    total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS month_rank
FROM MonthlyTransactionSummary
ORDER BY customer_id, month_year

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) AS max_dt FROM Financial_Transactions),
     prev_year AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', max_dt) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS yr FROM max_date),
     filtered AS (
        SELECT c.customer_id,
               strftime('%m', ft.transaction_date) AS month,
               ft.transaction_amount
        FROM Financial_Transactions ft
        JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
        CROSS JOIN prev_year
        WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) AS INTEGER) = prev_year.yr
     ),
     aggregated AS (
        SELECT customer_id,
               CAST(month AS INTEGER) AS month,
               SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_points
        FROM filtered
        GROUP BY customer_id, month
     )
SELECT
    customer_id,
    month,
    total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS month_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY customer_id, month;

WITH RECURSIVE high_risk_accounts AS (
        SELECT "account_id"
        FROM "Accounts"
        WHERE "other_account_details" = 'VIP'
    ),
    seed_transactions AS (
        SELECT ft."transaction_id",
               ft."transaction_amount",
               ft."previous_transaction_id",
               1 AS depth
        FROM "Financial_Transactions" ft
        JOIN high_risk_accounts hra ON ft."account_id" = hra."account_id"
    ),
    recursive_chain AS (
        SELECT transaction_id,
               transaction_amount,
               previous_transaction_id,
               depth
        FROM seed_transactions
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ft."transaction_id",
               ft."transaction_amount",
               ft."previous_transaction_id",
               rc.depth + 1
        FROM "Financial_Transactions" ft
        JOIN recursive_chain rc ON ft."transaction_id" = rc.previous_transaction_id
    )
SELECT MAX(depth) AS max_depth,
       SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_monetary_volume
FROM recursive_chain;

WITH RECURSIVE TransactionChain AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.transaction_id,
        ft.previous_transaction_id,
        ft.account_id,
        ft.transaction_amount,
        1 as depth
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    INNER JOIN Accounts acc ON ft.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE acc.other_account_details = 'High Risk'
      AND ft.previous_transaction_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ft.transaction_id,
        ft.previous_transaction_id,
        ft.account_id,
        ft.transaction_amount,
        tc.depth + 1
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    INNER JOIN TransactionChain tc ON ft.previous_transaction_id = tc.transaction_id
)
SELECT MAX(depth) as max_depth, SUM(transaction_amount) as total_volume
FROM TransactionChain;

WITH high_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM Accounts
    WHERE other_account_details = 'VIP'
),
chain AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_id,
           ft.previous_transaction_id,
           ft.transaction_amount,
           1 AS depth,
           ft.transaction_amount AS total_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN high_accounts ha ON ft.account_id = ha.account_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ft.transaction_id,
           ft.previous_transaction_id,
           ft.transaction_amount,
           c.depth + 1,
           c.total_amount + ft.transaction_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN chain c ON ft.previous_transaction_id = c.transaction_id
)
SELECT MAX(depth) AS max_depth,
       SUM(CASE WHEN depth = (SELECT MAX(depth) FROM chain) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_monetary_volume
FROM chain;

WITH fee_transactions AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_id,
           ft.card_id,
           ft.transaction_amount,
           ft.transaction_date,
           strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS year_month,
           cc.customer_id
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'LateFee'            -- assumes late‑payment fees are recorded with this type
      AND cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           card_id,
           year_month,
           SUM(transaction_amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM fee_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, card_id, year_month
),
latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(transaction_date) AS max_dt FROM fee_transactions
),
six_month_window AS (
    SELECT DATE((SELECT max_dt FROM latest_date), '-5 months') AS start_dt
),
customer_six_month_totals AS (
    SELECT ft.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS six_month_total
    FROM fee_transactions ft, six_month_window w
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= w.start_dt
    GROUP BY ft.customer_id
)
SELECT mt.customer_id,
       c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       mt.card_id,
       mt.year_month,
       mt.monthly_total,
       cstm.six_month_total,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cstm.six_month_total DESC) AS customer_rank
FROM monthly_totals mt
JOIN customer_six_month_totals cstm ON mt.customer_id = cstm.customer_id
JOIN Customers c ON mt.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cstm.six_month_total DESC, mt.customer_id, mt.year_month;

WITH monthly_late_fees AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS transaction_month,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS monthly_late_fee_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    INNER JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    INNER JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
      AND (LOWER(ft.transaction_type) LIKE '%late%' 
           OR LOWER(ft.transaction_type) LIKE '%fee%')
      AND ft.transaction_amount > 0
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date)
),
cumulative_fees AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        transaction_month,
        monthly_late_fee_total,
        SUM(monthly_late_fee_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY transaction_month 
            ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS six_month_cumulative
    FROM monthly_late_fees
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        transaction_month,
        monthly_late_fee_total,
        six_month_cumulative,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY six_month_cumulative DESC) AS customer_rank
    FROM cumulative_fees
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    transaction_month,
    monthly_late_fee_total,
    six_month_cumulative,
    customer_rank
FROM ranked_customers;

WITH card_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        cc.card_id,
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(strftime('%m', ft.transaction_date) AS INTEGER)) AS month_idx,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
      AND ft.transaction_type = 'Late Payment Fee'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, cc.card_id, month_idx
),
customer_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_idx,
        SUM(monthly_total) AS customer_monthly_total
    FROM card_monthly
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_idx
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_idx,
        SUM(customer_monthly_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_idx
            ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cum_6month
    FROM customer_monthly
),
latest_cum AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(cum_6month) AS cum_6month
    FROM cumulative
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cum_6month DESC) AS rank
    FROM latest_cum
)
SELECT rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT
    ft.account_id,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS interest_earned
FROM
    Financial_Transactions ft
WHERE
    ft.transaction_type = 'Interest'
    AND ft.transaction_date >= date('now','-1 month','start of month')
    AND ft.transaction_date < date('now','start of month')
GROUP BY
    ft.account_id
ORDER BY
    interest_earned DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS interest_earned FROM Accounts a INNER JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND ft.transaction_date < date('now', 'start of month') GROUP BY a.account_id;

SELECT "Accounts"."account_name",
       COALESCE(SUM("Financial_Transactions"."transaction_amount"), 0) AS interest_earned
FROM "Accounts"
JOIN "Financial_Transactions" ON "Accounts"."account_id" = "Financial_Transactions"."account_id"
WHERE "Financial_Transactions"."transaction_type" = 'Interest'
  AND "Financial_Transactions"."transaction_date" >= date((SELECT MAX("transaction_date") FROM "Financial_Transactions"), 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND "Financial_Transactions"."transaction_date" < date((SELECT MAX("transaction_date") FROM "Financial_Transactions"), 'start of month')
GROUP BY "Accounts"."account_name"
ORDER BY interest_earned DESC;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       cc.card_type_code,
       SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent_usd
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
  AND ft.transaction_comment LIKE '%overseas%'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, cc.card_type_code
ORDER BY c.customer_id, cc.card_type_code;

SELECT cc.customer_id, cc.card_type_code, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
GROUP BY cc.customer_id, cc.card_type_code

SELECT SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
WHERE lower(ft.transaction_comment) LIKE '%overseas%'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, cc.card_type_code;

votes.sql:
SELECT
    GROUP_CONCAT(cc.card_number) AS credit_score,
    COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_spending
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    AND ft.transaction_date >= date('now','-3 months')
    AND ft.transaction_date <= date('now')
WHERE a.account_name = 'VIP'
  AND cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
GROUP BY c.customer_id;

SELECT
    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_spending
FROM Customers c
INNER JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
INNER JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
WHERE a.account_name = 'VIP'
  AND ft.transaction_date >= DATE((SELECT MAX(transaction_date) FROM Financial_Transactions), '-90 days')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name

WITH vip_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM "Accounts" a
    JOIN "Customers" c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE a.other_account_details = 'VIP'
)
SELECT
    NULL AS credit_score,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_spending
FROM vip_customers vc
JOIN "Customers_Cards" cc ON vc.customer_id = cc.customer_id
JOIN "Financial_Transactions" ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date((SELECT MAX(transaction_date) FROM "Financial_Transactions"), '-3 months');

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT a.other_account_details AS tier,
           c.customer_id,
           c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date)), 0) AS avg_spend,
           MAX(ft.transaction_date) AS last_tx_date
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tier, c.customer_id
)
SELECT tier,
       full_name,
       avg_spend,
       last_tx_date
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY avg_spend DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_stats
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY tier, avg_spend DESC;

        ft.transaction_amount,
        ft.transaction_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS ym
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft

),

        ym,
        SUM(transaction_amount) AS month_total

    GROUP BY customer_id, ym
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.customer_id,
        AVG(m.month_total) AS avg_monthly_spend,
        MAX(fa.transaction_date) AS last_transaction_date
    FROM monthly m
    JOIN ft_acc fa ON m.customer_id = fa.customer_id
    GROUP BY m.customer_id
)

    tier,
    full_name,
    avg_monthly_spend,
    last_transaction_date
FROM (

        c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
        cs.avg_monthly_spend,
        cs.last_transaction_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.other_account_details ORDER BY cs.avg_monthly_spend DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_stats cs
    JOIN Customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY tier, avg_monthly_spend DESC;

WITH credit_fees AS (
        SELECT cc.customer_id,
               SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_fee
        FROM Financial_Transactions ft
        JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
        WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
          AND ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
          AND ft.transaction_date >= '2018-03-01'
          AND ft.transaction_date < '2018-04-01'
        GROUP BY cc.customer_id
    ),
    total_tx AS (
        SELECT cc.customer_id,
               SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
        FROM Financial_Transactions ft
        JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
        WHERE ft.transaction_date >= '2018-03-01'
          AND ft.transaction_date < '2018-04-01'
        GROUP BY cc.customer_id
    )
SELECT cu.customer_first_name,
       cu.customer_last_name,
       cf.total_fee,
       (cf.total_fee / tt.total_amount) * 100.0 AS fee_percentage
FROM credit_fees cf
JOIN total_tx tt ON cf.customer_id = tt.customer_id
JOIN Customers cu ON cf.customer_id = cu.customer_id
ORDER BY cf.total_fee DESC;

WITH March_2018_Payments AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS payment_fees,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transactions
    FROM Customers_Cards cc
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= '2018-03-01'
      AND ft.transaction_date < '2018-04-01'
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name,
    m.payment_fees AS total_fee_amount,
    ROUND(m.payment_fees * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_transactions, 0), 2) AS fee_percentage
FROM Customers c
JOIN March_2018_Payments m ON c.customer_id = m.customer_id
ORDER BY total_fee_amount DESC;

WITH cust_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS fee_amount,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= '2018-03-01'
      AND ft.transaction_date < '2018-04-01'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
)
    SELECT
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        fee_amount,
        CASE WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE ROUND(fee_amount * 100.0 / total_amount, 2)
        END AS fee_percentage
    FROM cust_agg
    ORDER BY fee_amount DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH
cust_spent AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
cust_latest_tx AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_id,
           ft.account_id,
           ft.previous_transaction_id,
           a.customer_id AS cust_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY ft.transaction_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
),
direct_referral AS (
    SELECT clt.cust_id AS customer_id,
           prev.cust_id AS referrer_id
    FROM cust_latest_tx clt
    LEFT JOIN cust_latest_tx prev ON clt.previous_transaction_id = prev.transaction_id
    WHERE clt.rn = 1
),
referral_tree AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           referrer_id,
           0 AS lvl,
           customer_id || '' AS path
    FROM direct_referral
    WHERE referrer_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.customer_id,
           d.referrer_id,
           rt.lvl + 1,
           rt.path || '.' || d.customer_id
    FROM direct_referral d
    JOIN referral_tree rt ON d.referrer_id = rt.customer_id
)
SELECT rt.customer_id,
       cs.total_spent,
       rt.path AS referral_path,
       rt.lvl AS depth
FROM referral_tree rt
JOIN cust_spent cs ON rt.customer_id = cs.customer_id
ORDER BY rt.path;

WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount),0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    NULL AS credit_score,
    NULL AS predicted_fraud_risk_level,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS overspending_rank
FROM customer_spend;

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT 
        c.card_type_code,
        strftime('%Y-%W', ft.transaction_date) AS week,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_fees
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards c ON ft.card_id = c.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date('now', '-6 months')
    GROUP BY c.card_type_code, week
)
SELECT
    card_type_code,
    week,
    total_fees,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (total_fees - prev_total) * 100.0 / prev_total
        END
    , 2) AS week_over_week_pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT
        card_type_code,
        week,
        total_fees,
        LAG(total_fees) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type_code ORDER BY week) AS prev_total
    FROM weekly
) 
ORDER BY card_type_code, week;

WITH weekly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.card_type_code,
        strftime('%Y-W%W', ft.transaction_date) AS week_period,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_fees
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    INNER JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-6 months')
    GROUP BY cc.card_type_code, strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date), strftime('%W', ft.transaction_date)
),
weekly_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        card_type_code,
        week_period,
        total_transaction_fees,
        LAG(total_transaction_fees) OVER (
            PARTITION BY card_type_code 
            ORDER BY strftime('%Y', week_period), CAST(SUBSTR(week_period, 5) AS INTEGER)
        ) AS prev_week_fees
    FROM weekly_totals
)
SELECT 
    card_type_code,
    week_period,
    total_transaction_fees,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_week_fees IS NULL OR prev_week_fees = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((total_transaction_fees - prev_week_fees) * 100.0 / prev_week_fees, 2)
    END AS week_over_week_pct_change
FROM weekly_with_prev
ORDER BY card_type_code, week_period;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_amount, ft.transaction_date, cc.card_type_code
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date((SELECT MAX(transaction_date) FROM Financial_Transactions), '-6 months')
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%W', transaction_date) AS week,
        card_type_code,
        SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_fee
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY week, card_type_code
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        week,
        card_type_code,
        total_fee,
        LAG(total_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type_code ORDER BY week) AS prev_total_fee
    FROM weekly
)
SELECT
    week,
    card_type_code AS card_type,
    total_fee,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_total_fee IS NULL OR prev_total_fee = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((total_fee - prev_total_fee) * 100.0) / prev_total_fee, 2)
    END AS week_over_week_pct_change
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY card_type_code, week;

GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       (SUM(ft.transaction_amount) / 12.0) AS avg_monthly_transaction_amount
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
  AND cc.other_card_details LIKE '%Chicago%'
  AND ft.transaction_date >= date('now','-1 year')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name

SELECT c.customer_id, AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS average_monthly_transaction_amount FROM Customers c JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit' AND ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-1 year') GROUP BY c.customer_id

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) AS max_dt FROM Financial_Transactions),
     filtered_trans AS (
         SELECT ft.transaction_amount, ft.account_id
         FROM Financial_Transactions ft
         JOIN max_date md ON 1=1
         WHERE ft.transaction_date >= DATE(md.max_dt, '-1 year')
     ),
     cust_with_credit AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
         FROM Customers c
         JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
         WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
     )
SELECT c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS customer_name,
       SUM(ft.transaction_amount) / 12.0 AS avg_monthly_transaction_amount
FROM cust_with_credit cwc
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = cwc.customer_id
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN filtered_trans ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name;

SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub.cnt DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT cc.customer_id,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Customers_Cards cc
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
) AS sub
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = sub.customer_id
ORDER BY rank;

WITH CustomerTransactionCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
    HAVING COUNT(ft.transaction_id) > 10
)
SELECT 
    customer_first_name,
    customer_last_name,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY transaction_count DESC) AS rank
FROM CustomerTransactionCounts;

WITH cust_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        MAX(CAST(a.account_name AS INTEGER)) AS credit_score,
        COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS txn_count
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
)
SELECT
    customer_first_name,
    customer_last_name,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY credit_score DESC) AS score_rank
FROM cust_data
WHERE txn_count > 10;

votes.sql:
WITH TransactionDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        ft.transaction_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS TEXT) AS year_month,
        ft.transaction_amount
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
),
CustomerMonthlySpending AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        transaction_type,
        year_month,
        SUM(transaction_amount) AS monthly_spending
    FROM TransactionDetails
    GROUP BY customer_id, transaction_type, year_month
),
TransactionVolumeByType AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        transaction_type,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id, transaction_type 
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM TransactionDetails
    GROUP BY customer_id, transaction_type
)
SELECT 
    csm.customer_id,
    csm.transaction_type,
    ROUND(AVG(csm.monthly_spending), 2) AS avg_monthly_spending
FROM CustomerMonthlySpending csm
JOIN TransactionVolumeByType tvbt 
    ON csm.customer_id = tvbt.customer_id 
    AND csm.transaction_type = tvbt.transaction_type
WHERE tvbt.rn <= 3
GROUP BY csm.customer_id, csm.transaction_type;

WITH yearly_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date('now', '-1 year')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    HAVING total_spent >= 5000
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       a.account_name,
       CASE 
           WHEN a.other_account_details = 'VIP' THEN 'Cashback 5% + Priority Support'
           ELSE 'Standard Points + Monthly Offers'
       END AS reward_benefit
FROM yearly_spending ys
JOIN Customers c ON ys.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_spending, a.other_account_details FROM Customers c JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, a.account_id ORDER BY total_transaction_spending DESC
